verdict.rationale: Devin's first-party docs explicitly say you can ask Devin to tackle Linear and Jira tickets. MCP integrations can also connect it to issue trackers, and Slack/Teams tagging can start sessions from bug discussions. However, this rests on one brief docs line, and the ticket-to-session workflow itself is not documented. Missing for 10: documentation of how a task is triggered from inside Linear/Jira (e.g., assigning or labeling a ticket), how ticket context is carried into the session, coverage of other trackers such as GitHub Issues, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
